description: The file defines the 'PoolController' class within the Goteo project, handling various stages of investment pooling operations, including validation, payment processing, and user data management.

classes.name: PoolController
classes.description: Controller class managing the investment pool workflow, including validation, payment process, user data collection, and social sharing features.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller, sets theme, checks if pool payments are active, and creates sidebar.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates project availability for investing, manages user login requirements, and sets up view variables.

methods.name: selectAmountAction
methods.description: Handles the first step: choosing investment amount and rewards.

methods.name: selectPaymentMethodAction
methods.description: Handles the second step: selecting the payment method and preparing for payment.

methods.name: paymentFormAction
methods.description: Processes the third step: submitting payment details to the payment gateway and initiating the transaction.

methods.name: completePaymentAction
methods.description: Completes the payment process after redirection from the gateway, updating investment status accordingly.

methods.name: userDataAction
methods.description: Handles displaying and submitting user data and address details post-investment or reward.

methods.name: shareAction
methods.description: Displays social sharing options after an investment is made.
